proposal.summary: Public exploit code for Source Engine (CS:GO, TF2, Garry's Mod, Half Life 2 build IDs listed) that demonstrates achieving arbitrary code execution by injecting shell commands into a relaunch payload written to /tmp/hl2_relaunch.
proposal.affected_product: Source Engine; CS:GO BuildID: 4937372, TF2 BuildID: 4871679, Garry's Mod BuildID: 4803834, Half Life 2 BuildID: 4233302
